<kb_source id="products#golden-tips-black" title="Product Catalogue">
Golden Tips Black

SKU: HT-BLK-002
Category: black
Origin: hand-picked golden buds from a cooperative garden in Ilam.
Tasting notes: honey, cocoa and sweet potato, very smooth.
Brewing: 90–95°C for four minutes.
Similar teas: Ilam Second Flush Black.
</kb_source>

</kb_source>

<kb_source id="products#saffron-royal-chai" title="Product Catalogue">
